svg.title: 200 float32 features: Go row maps versus Arrow columns
svg.desc: One Go map[string]any per record reserves 256 slots in 32 groups, 200 used and 56 spare, for about 10,368 bytes per record. 200 Arrow Float32 columns store contiguous values for 825 bytes per record. Go maps use about 12.6 times as much memory. Layout estimate for Go 1.24 on 64-bit.
svg.text: MEMORY LAYOUT • 200 FLOAT32 FEATURES PER RECORD
Go row maps vs Apache Arrow columns
Go maps use ≈12.6× as much memory as Arrow
